name: Scrape Creators
description: Scrape Creators lets agents read public profiles, posts, and comments from social platforms such as TikTok, Instagram, and YouTube. At sign-in the user enters a Scrape Creators API key in the browser, and each request uses account credits.

prompts.text: Get the latest 10 posts from the @nasa Instagram account.
Compare the TikTok follower counts of @nike and @adidas.
Summarize the latest videos on the MKBHD YouTube channel.

apps.name: Scrape Creators
apps.description: Public social media profiles and posts, over Scrape Creators' MCP server with browser sign-in.
